batch.topic: An experiment changes two factors together and therefore cannot identify either factor’s separate effect from that comparison alone.
A dataset is shuffled before a split, but records from one source document must still remain in the same subset; random order does not imply independence.
A function returns a new array while leaving its input array unchanged; distinguish returning a value from modifying an argument.
A proof establishes that a condition is sufficient without establishing necessity; a counterexample to necessity does not refute sufficiency.
